Title: IoT Hub message enrichment is now available

Body.Content:
IoT Hub message enrichments is now generally available. This is a new capability in IoT Hub to stamp additional information and enrich messages egressed from IoT Hub with custom application properties per endpoint. Users will get an easy way to append up to 10 enrichments per IoT Hub, such as IoT Hub name, device twin tags/properties, or any static string, on all data sources (telemetry, device twin change notification, and device lifecycle) sending messages to that endpoint. This supports built-in endpoint with or without message routing, as well as custom endpoints and event grid subscriptions to device telemetry messages.
